purpose: A measurable, fail-closed contract for translating an ordinary reference video into renderable evidence.

frames.value: every source frame in the selected interval

segmentationMatting.method: temporal semantic-owner segmentation with per-frame alpha matting and explicit residual canvas
segmentationMatting.ownerMask: one measured mask per independently visible title word, subtitle, UI owner, and effect owner

alpha.report: per-frame measured alpha threshold and retained coverage

ownerAssociation.report: pixel overlap, centroid continuity, and temporal field variation

ownerEffectAssociation.ownership: every effect has an ownerId or is explicitly global

cameraMotion.cameraPath: must be separated from object trajectories

rhythm.easing: derived from measured trajectory samples, never invented prose

residualCanvas.rule: retain measured pixels and temporal variation not owned by a semantic layer

audioCues.cues: measured onset, duration, and level for each SFX/music anchor

vlmLabelOnlyBoundaries.VLM: may propose labels, owner names, and semantic categories only
vlmLabelOnlyBoundaries.label: is metadata, not measurement
vlmLabelOnlyBoundaries.measurementAuthority: pixel and temporal measurements remain authoritative
vlmLabelOnlyBoundaries.prohibition: VLM cannot delete, replace, invent, or hide any pixel/temporal-measured layer
vlmLabelOnlyBoundaries.failClosed: a VLM deletion or replacement attempt emits VLM_DELETED_MEASUREMENT
